title: A line built from an inspection behaves like any approved line
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Open a work order for a customer and asset (Work Orders > New, pick the customer/unit).
  4. ↳ Start an inspection from a template that has a checkbox field; mark one field Not OK and one Monitor.
  5. ↳ Complete and sign the inspection so it is in its read-only completed view.
  6. ↳ Note the shop's "automatically approve work order lines" setting and its default labor type (Settings - Service).
custom_steps:
1. Build the lines and open the target work order's Lines tab.
2. Check each Monitor/Not OK finding produced at least one line, and that a line is indistinguishable from a typed one.
3. Check the line's approval state against the shop setting, its labor type/rate, and the carried time estimate (editable; zero if none proposed).
4. Confirm the line did not arrive as a Fixed Line Total line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every Monitor and Not OK finding is represented by at least one line, with ShopCoach composing each line's name, description, time estimate and parts from the finding.
  • A generated line then behaves as an ordinary work order line, indistinguishable from one a user typed.
  • Added lines arrive approved or awaiting authorisation according to the shop's setting for automatically approving lines, exactly as a manually added line does.
  • A work order already in Approved status does not need re-approval, because approval applies to lines rather than to the work order.
  • A generated line takes the shop's default labor type (or the first available if no default is set), and the labor rate follows from the labor type.
  • ShopCoach's proposed time estimate is carried onto the line and is editable before adding; where none is proposed the line arrives at zero.
  • A generated line never arrives as a Fixed Line Total line; it is an ordinary labor-and-parts line, and switching it to a fixed total stays a deliberate act afterwards.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9100 (S2 — Turn findings into work order lines); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S2; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “Every Monitor and Not OK finding will be represented by at least one line. ShopCoach composes each line's name, description, time estimate and parts; the field label, the measured value and the technician's note are inputs to that drafting rather than the line text itself (S15)”
  • S2-R2: “A generated line will behave as an ordinary work order line from that point on, indistinguishable from one a user typed”
  • S2-R7: “When the lines are added, they will arrive approved or awaiting authorisation according to the shop's existing setting for automatically approving work order lines, exactly as a manually added line does”
  • S2-R8: “A work order in Approved status will not require re-approval, because approval applies to lines rather than to the work order”
  • S2-R9: “A generated line will take the shop's default labor type, and where no default is set, the first labor type available to the shop. The labor rate will follow from the labor type. This is stated as a rule of its own rather than as a reference to the manual New Line form, whose fallback is behaviour of that form and not of the server”
  • S2-R10: “The time estimate ShopCoach proposes will be carried onto the line, and will be editable before the line is added. Where no estimate is proposed the line arrives at zero, to be estimated by whoever plans the work”
  • S2-R18: “A generated line never arrives as a Fixed Line Total line. It is an ordinary labor-and-parts line, and switching it to a fixed total stays a deliberate act afterwards. A fixed total requires labor plus parts to equal it exactly or the line cannot be saved, and a drafted line arrives carrying both figures”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
